title: MCQ: What does `f(4)` return?

tests.name: D D

tests.hint: D. The chain is f(0)=1, then +1, +2, +3, +4 → 11. A is 1+2+3+4 without the base case's extra 1 (i.e. f(0)=0 thinking); B/C stop the chain early or double-count the base.
